description: Create a creative from a READY image or video: WEB_VIEW (default; swipe-up opens a web page) or SNAP_AD (the Snap only, no link and no call to action). DYNAMIC_PRODUCT is a catalog ad creative: no media; it needs dynamic_template_id and product_set_id, and the product pages come from the catalog. Use the result in snap_create_ad, or as a part of a Story with snap_create_story_creative. Previews unless confirm=true. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

product_set_id.description: DYNAMIC_PRODUCT only: must be the product set of the ad squad that will run this creative

url.description: https:// landing page (required for WEB_VIEW, not allowed for SNAP_AD)

name: snap_create_creative
